title: Editor Composite Preview Child Visual Selection Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, and Editor boundary context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, Work path, owner repository, terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, and the bounded composite preview child visual selection target are reviewed before implementation.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor with bounded repo-backend/repo-core smoke references, phase phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-composite-preview-child-visual-selection, checklist checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-composite-preview-child-visual-selection, and evidence target evidence-editor-composite-preview-child-visual-selection-2026-08-31 before product edits.

items.label: Write failing Editor and Project Control tests before accepting the selected child visual state.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests fail before columns/table Preview children expose selected visual state, and Project Control test fails before this phase/evidence exists.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included npm run test -- --run src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts failing for missing data-canvas-text-descendant-selected, npm run test -- --run src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts failing for missing preview selected/style observations, and npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts failing before the new phase was registered.

items.label: Propagate selectedNodeId into composite Paper preview content without changing surface identity.
items.evidenceTarget: PaperPage passes selectedNodeId to PaperBlock, and PaperBlock marks only represented editable text-block descendants that match that selected id.
items.verificationNote: PaperBlock derives selected preview targets from editableTextDescendants and preview label matching, adds data-canvas-text-descendant-selected only to the selected child target, keeps the owning surface data-node-id, and keeps the parent data-selected false when a child is selected.

items.label: Style selected columns/table Preview children as stable mini objects.
items.evidenceTarget: Selected preview descendants are visibly boxed with stable background, border, inset highlight, and pointer cursor without layout resize.
items.verificationNote: editor.css styles data-canvas-text-descendant-selected targets with rgb(238, 249, 247) background, rgb(30, 111, 103) border color, inset/outer focus-colored box-shadow, and pointer cursor while preserving fixed border widths and existing preview card/cell dimensions.

items.label: Prove selected preview child state through a live local Backend browser smoke.
items.evidenceTarget: The retained browser smoke clicks summary-left-text in the Paper Preview, verifies Outline selection, verifies selected Preview child ids before and after reload, and records computed style for the visible selected child.
items.verificationNote: The retained smoke records selectionMethod canvas-text-descendant-preview, selectedPreviewTextDescendantIds [summary-left-text], reloadedSelectedPreviewTextDescendantIds [summary-left-text], previewHitTargetSelected true, reloadedPreviewHitTargetSelected true, and computed visual style values for the selected preview child.

items.label: Keep the slice visual-selection-only and preserve mutation/readiness boundaries.
items.evidenceTarget: The change does not enable direct typing, contenteditable, WYSIWYG, exact table/cell authoring, new Backend mutation sources, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, broad readiness, or map truth.
items.verificationNote: No Core or Backend files changed. Editor mutation source exclusions from the previous slice remain unchanged. This slice changes only Paper preview selection state, CSS, tests, and retained smoke evidence.

items.label: Run worktree and merged-main Editor gates and record cleanup state honestly.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor worktree and merged main pass focused tests, full check, and no-write live Backend browser smoke; cleanup risks remain explicit.
